FAQ.title: Common Questions About Songtell
FAQ.description: A clear guide to turning one meaningful story into a song you can personalize, preview, and share.

items.question: What is a personalized song?
items.answer: A personalized song is an original song made for a specific person, relationship, or moment. Songtell uses the names, memories, message, and musical feeling you share to create custom lyrics and melody that are unique to your story.

items.question: How does Songtell create a personalized song?
items.answer: Share the people, memories, and feeling you want to capture, then choose a musical direction. Songtell creates an original preview with lyrics and melody so you can hear the idea before deciding whether to unlock the finished song.

items.question: What occasions can I make a Songtell song for?
items.answer: Songtell works for anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, proposals, apologies, long-distance relationships, family milestones, gratitude, and the moments that do not fit a standard greeting card.

items.question: Can I change the lyrics, genre, or vocal direction?
items.answer: Yes. You can refine the wording, try another genre, and adjust the vocal direction while shaping the song. The preview lets you make creative decisions before unlocking the final track.

items.question: What do I receive when the song is ready?
items.answer: You receive a playable song page with a shareable link. Depending on your project, you can also create a lyric video, add a spoken opening, or turn the lyrics into printable wall art.

items.question: Can I listen before I pay, and is checkout secure?
items.answer: You can preview the song before unlocking the final version. Checkout is handled securely by Creem, and Songtell does not store your full card details on its servers.

items.question: Can I revisit my songs and creative projects later?
items.answer: Finalized songs and related projects are connected to your account so you can return to replay, share, or download them. Keep your login details safe so your gifts remain easy to find.

items.question: Do I need an account before I start?
items.answer: No. You can begin with your story and explore a preview first. When you are ready to save or unlock your work, Songtell will guide you through signing in with the available account options.

items.question: What should I do if a song is still generating?
items.answer: Give the generation a moment. We will email the customer as soon as the song is ready. Refresh the project if the status does not change. If the issue continues, contact support with the project details so the team can investigate it.
